name: Hung Ching Development & Construction Co. Ltd
summary: Hung Ching Development & Construction Co. Ltd. engages in the development and construction of residential and commercial buildings for rent and sale, and other related businesses in Taiwan and China. The company operates through Property Development; Construction; Lease; and Other segments. It also engages in the retail of household appliances and supplies; construction engineering contracting; leasing of shopping mall and office building; real estate development; technical consulting services of electronic engineering and architectural engineering; and operates department stores and parking lots.
